Author: Valentina Vieri
Name: VieriNexus
Punchline: Record, refine, preview, and safely play Nexus-owned routes.
Description: The unified, modular Vieri suite in active development. Routes & Navigation provides streamlined route creation, recording and editing, 27 verified gear-vendor templates, one-click local, cross-zone, and inn-room playback through the suite travel provider, immediate Stop/restart, manual takeover across the complete trip, live previews, and automatic authority whenever VieriNavPlotter is not loaded.
